# compress_array { #spikepack.compress_array }

```python
compress_array(arr)
```

Compress a numpy array with Blosc(zstd, shuffle).

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name    | Type   | Description                                                           |
|---------|--------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|
| payload | bytes  | Compressed byte payload.                                              |
| spec    | dict   | `dtype`, `shape`, `nbytes`, `compressed_nbytes` needed to decompress. |
